name: openaudible
description: Search an OpenAudible audiobook library and fetch M4B, MP3 or Yoto-ready audio from its web server.

url.title: OpenAudible URL
url.description: Address of the OpenAudible web server (File > Preferences > Web Server), e.g. http://my-mac.local:8000

username.title: Username
username.description: Web server user. An Admin account can also prepare books and run commands. Leave empty if the server has no login.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password for that user. Kept in your system keychain.

download_dir.title: Download folder
download_dir.description: Where audio is saved. Empty means ~/Downloads/OpenAudible.

mp3_bitrate.title: MP3 bitrate
mp3_bitrate.description: Bitrate for MP3s made on this computer, and the highest used for Yoto tracks.
